description: This file contains utility classes and methods for handling F# union and record types within the Orleans code generator, including type description classes and attribute-based type identification methods.

classes.name: FSharpUtilities
classes.description: Contains static methods for identifying F# union and record types based on attributes and flags, as well as nested classes for describing union cases and record fields.

classes.name: FSharpUnionCaseTypeDescription
classes.description: Represents the description of an F# union case type, including its data members and their metadata.

classes.name: FSharpUnionCaseFieldDescription
classes.description: Describes a field within an F# union case, including its type, name, and accessor methods.

classes.name: FSharpRecordTypeDescription
classes.description: Represents the description of an F# record type, including its properties and their metadata.

classes.name: FSharpRecordPropertyDescription
classes.description: Describes a property within an F# record, including its type, name, and accessor methods.

methods.name: IsUnionCase
methods.description: Determines if a given symbol represents an F# union case based on attributes and flags.

methods.name: IsRecord
methods.description: Determines if a given symbol represents an F# record based on attributes and flags.
